messages.subject: rhtml script error
parts:
Hi,
from few days I installed Rapache in a Ubuntu 11.10 using
documentation in Rapache web site and this (http://www.zh-cn.org/en/
2011/05/19/english-setting-up-a-rapache-environment/) setup example.
After the installation I tried to create a helloworld2.rhtml using
script by example in this video http://youtu.be/fB_7_RZgasg, but
Apache server return Internal Server Error and in the error.log file
there are this lines:
[Wed Mar 21 10:05:33 2012] [error] [client 127.0.0.1] rApache Notice!
Error in parse("/var/www/rapache/test/helloworld2.r") :
/var/www/rapache/test/helloworld2.r:1:1: unexpected '<'
1: <

Do you have a suggestion or input for this problem?

Thanks in advance.
Alessandro
